contract_clauses: RuntimeJournalEvent::Resumed must map to JournalEvent::RunResumed in StorageRuntimeJournal::storage_event, preserving the per-run EventSeq supplied by the shard and converting the u64 seconds-since-epoch timestamp to DateTime<Utc>.

The synthetic JournalEvent::RunFailedEvent fallback in storage_event (chunk_002.rs:298-302) must not silently rewrite Resumed (or any other unmatched runtime event); Resumed must reach RunResumed before the fallback would fire.
StorageRuntimeJournal::storage_event must remain total over RuntimeJournalEvent so that vb-edvbj can delete the RunFailedEvent fallback without breaking dispatch.

The single-clone invariant asserted by storage_event_clones_the_event_exactly_once_per_dispatch (journal/tests/chunk_002.rs:410-493) must continue to hold after the Resumed arm is added (one full-event clone per dispatch).
Recovery/replay must classify JournalEvent::RunResumed as LifecycleState::Active (storage/journal/incident.rs:203); emitting RunFailedEvent in its place is a hydration correctness violation.
notes: Bead fix is local to crates/vb_runtime/src/journal/chunk_002.rs (StorageRuntimeJournal::storage_event dispatch chain) and tests in crates/vb_runtime/src/journal/tests/chunk_002.rs. Catch-all being deleted in vb-edvbj is the synthetic Ok(JournalEvent::RunFailedEvent{...}) fallback at chunk_002.rs:298-302; once vb-edvbj removes it, storage_event must be exhaustive over RuntimeJournalEvent, which is why Resumed needs an explicit arm.
